messages:
Lina: Morning — quick async check for SDKs / quickstarts / sample app. What I did: updated Python quickstart to the new auth flow and opened docs PR #482. Blockers: sampleapp Docker image fails on M1 (arm64 manifest?) and samples CI is flaky on windows node. Today: triage CI, ping reviewers, try a local M1 repro.

Aisha (Docs): thanks — will review the PR this afternoon, can you add a brief note in the migration guide about the auth change? :+1:

Tom (SDK): noted CI flakiness — I saw a failing test in the node client related to streaming. I can take a look after standup. If you have the failing job URL I can attach local repro steps.

Lina: job -> https://ci.internal/runs/6789 . Fail is `streaming.test.js` timeout. Repro command: `npm run test -- streaming.test.js` — timeout at `20000ms`.

Tom (SDK): got it. I'll run `node --trace_gc` and see memory/time. Might be a race introduced by the last batching change.

Amy (Samples): for the M1 Docker issue — the sampleapp Dockerfile uses a base image that doesn't have an arm64 manifest. Quick workaround: add a multi-arch build in the GH action:

```yaml
- name: Build multi-arch
  uses: docker/build-push-action@v3
  with:
    platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
    push: false
```

I'll prototype locally and open a PR if that helps.

Mike (Eng): pinging reviewer lane — @Aisha and @Tom pls triage docs + SDK review. If CI remains flaky, we should enable the `allow-failures` toggle for samples test on the flaky job so we don't block docs ship.

Lina: thanks. Aisha — if you can review before EOD I'll merge and trigger a deploy. Amy — PR for multi-arch would be great, thx. Tom — any ETA on streaming test fix?

Tom (SDK): aiming for 2-3 hours. If I can't repro locally I'll drop a WIP fix and request quick review.

ci-bot: build 6789 finished: partially failed — 4 failing, 12 passed. See https://ci.internal/runs/6789/logs

Aisha (Docs): assigning myself to the migration note. Lina, can you add one sentence to PR describing why we changed the auth header? I'll do the rest.

Lina: added note in PR body and linked migration guide. Also added `—arm64` build hint in sample README.

Amy (Samples): opened draft PR for GH action multi-arch: #489 (WIP). Includes matrix and cache tweaks.

Mike (Eng): if tests are still flaky after Tom's work, we'll schedule a quick pairing session tomorrow 10am PT.

Lina: great. I'll follow up in this thread after CI rerun. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Tom (SDK): thanks — will update here when I have a repro or fix.

Lina: (later) CI rerun: https://ci.internal/runs/6790 — streaming test is green after bumping async timeout to 30s in the client test; Tom opened PR #490. Marking as resolved for today's triage.

Aisha (Docs): merged docs PR and deployed site. Noted a small formatting regression, filing issue #491.

Amy (Samples): merged multi-arch action, sample image builds locally for arm64. Will monitor nightly builds.

Lina: awesome — closing this async check. If anything else crops up ping here or DM.
